firstBatch.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a NEW professional identity proposal for the personal creative website named exactly "Little Stone Still Here", abbreviated "LSSH". Owner's nickname means little stone. Brand idea: even when a person is absent, their writing, learning, photographs, work and music leave a perceptible presence for another person to encounter. Emotional character: quiet, expansive, psychedelic in a subtle perceptual sense, tender; formal character: rounded, restrained, distinctive. Pink Floyd is an underlying conceptual inspiration (Echoes: mutual recognition across distance; Dark Side: time and refraction; The Wall: isolation and openings; Wish You Were Here: absence and presence), not imagery to copy.
Art direction: a highly resolved bespoke visual identity with an unforgettable silhouette and intelligent negative space. Mature editorial/art institution/music imprint sensibility. This is a designer's final serious logo study, not an app icon pack. Invest in optical proportions, curve continuity, figure-ground tension and visual balance. Flat off-white shapes on an entirely pure black canvas, pristine hard edges. The logo must be inherently beautiful with no accompanying explanation. Rounded does not mean bubbly or childish. Use very few carefully sculpted elements; avoid cute doodles, clip art, generic tech icons, wifi arcs, rainbow prism triangles, orbit planets, door icons, droplet symbols, fingerprints, stock infinite loops, literal rock drawings, grids of ordinary initials. No 3D, shadows, mockup photographs, metal, glow, grain, gradient, texture, ornament, thin fragile hairlines.
Composition: one generous square black presentation, ONE logo proposal only; hero symbol centered in the upper-middle taking about 38% of canvas width, surrounded by expansive quiet space. Beneath the mark, exact small wordmark "Little Stone Still Here" in refined understated typography, correct spelling and capitalization, no comma. No other text, no captions, no border. Design a coherent visual relationship between wordmark and symbol.
DIRECTION FOR THIS SINGLE PROPOSAL:
PERSISTENCE: a grounded, asymmetrical, worn monolithic form whose flowing internal void makes it feel both enduring and changed by passing time. The void and outer silhouette must be inseparable, giving the impression of a presence that remains while something passes through. Conceive a striking sculptural sign with a low, poised center of gravity, not a circular pebble with a smile slit or an S stamped inside. A few expertly tuned contours; memorable as a silhouette.
